config.architecture: V4 849 params, no RR; original V4 untouched
config.baseline: Reuse exact Step1 V4 checkpoints trained on identical Fit/Checkpoint groups,seed,BCE,classweights,Adam.001,batch128,max20,patience5,no augmentation; source training metadata recorded, historical runtime environment incomplete
config.hard_mining: baseline best model scores on Fit only, NOT OOF; within each class select top10% loss (positive1-score,negative score), deterministic stable ties
config.weighting: 2x for hard Fit examples then normalize within class; multiply original Fit class weight; equivalent weighted exposure ~18.18% hard per class
config.threshold: same baseline grid .05.. .95 step.01 max combined Calibration PVC F1, tie precision then smaller threshold
config.single_factor: class-balanced Fit hardness weighting; no independent attribution to positive vs negative arms
config.passing_rule: both mean fold end-to-end F1 >= baseline; INC mean Recall increases; MIT mean Recall drop<=1pp; each mean FP/1000N increase <=max(1,10% baseline); worst fold F1 not worse on either dataset; >=60% patient/record groups with PVC have F1 drop<=2pp
config.evaluation_limit: Previously examined Train+Development; no Test; folds separate Fit/Checkpoint/Calibration/outer for each run; exploratory adaptive validation
